data.title: 伊雷娜 · 夜间魔法星夜
data.description: 【伊蕾娜 · 夜间魔法星夜】夜色笼罩长满青草的山丘，伊蕾娜挥动魔杖，将点点星芒汇成漂浮的星座光球。流星从深蓝天幕划过，远处营地的火光映着她的魔女装。她看着自己的小小星空露出得意的笑容——「把今晚的星光留在旅途中，也是很不错的纪念吧。」
data.action: 在夜间草丘挥动魔杖，施展汇聚星光的魔法
data.promptProse: On the grassy night hill, Elaina turns her wand through a star-gathering spell, luminous constellation orbs arranging beside her black witch dress and star brooch. Shooting stars trail across the deep-indigo sky beyond the medium view. A nearby campfire warms the dress's lower folds and grass tips, while starlight and the spell's glow illuminate her attentive face and lifted wand, separating her from the darker slope descending behind.
